```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6)
```

> **Purpose.** `malta_master_full_realloc.rds` (built by `Population_reallocation_malta.Rmd`) reallocated
> `Total_Population`/`Adult_Population` using a **different** method than Khomenko et al. (2021): broad
> residential definition (includes class `11300`), area-based zero-residential-land threshold, grouped by
> locality (`NAME`), with a nearest-neighbour fallback for orphan localities.
>
> This notebook builds a replacement, `malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko`, using the Khomenko
> reallocation instead (`Population_Malta_reallocated_khomenko.Rmd`: narrow residential definition,
> topological intersection test, grouped by `district`, skip/uniform fallbacks) -- for **both**
> `Total_Population` and `Adult_Population` (the latter extended in that notebook to also reallocate total
> population using the same method). `malta_master_full.rds` itself is untouched; every other column is
> carried over unchanged.

```{r libraries}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

data_dir <- here::here("data/malta")
```

# Load inputs

```{r load}
malta_master_full <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "malta_master_full.rds")) %>%
  mutate(gid = as.character(gid))

khomenko <- st_read(file.path(data_dir, "Population_Malta_reallocated_khomenko.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(gid = as.character(gid)) %>%
  select(gid, adult_khomenko = pop_reallocated, total_khomenko = total_reallocated)

cat("malta_master_full:", nrow(malta_master_full), "rows\n")
cat("khomenko:", nrow(khomenko), "rows\n")
cat("Total_Population (original):", sum(malta_master_full$Total_Population, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Adult_Population (original):", sum(malta_master_full$Adult_Population, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

# Build `malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko`

```{r build}
d <- malta_master_full %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(gid) %>%
  left_join(khomenko, by = "gid")

cat("NAs after join (adult):", sum(is.na(d$adult_khomenko)), "\n")
cat("NAs after join (total):", sum(is.na(d$total_khomenko)), "\n")

malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko <- malta_master_full
malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko$Total_Population <- d$total_khomenko
malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko$Adult_Population <- d$adult_khomenko

cat("\nColumns identical to original (besides the two population columns):",
    identical(setdiff(names(malta_master_full), c("Total_Population","Adult_Population")),
              setdiff(names(malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko), c("Total_Population","Adult_Population"))),
    "\n")
```

# Verification

## Global totals

```{r verify-global}
tibble(
  metric   = c("Total_Population", "Adult_Population"),
  original = c(sum(malta_master_full$Total_Population, na.rm = TRUE),
               sum(malta_master_full$Adult_Population, na.rm = TRUE)),
  khomenko = c(sum(malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko$Total_Population, na.rm = TRUE),
               sum(malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko$Adult_Population, na.rm = TRUE))
) %>%
  mutate(diff = khomenko - original) %>%
  kable(caption = "National totals: original vs Khomenko-reallocated", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Sanity check: histograms of the change

```{r sanity-hist, fig.height=4}
diff_df <- tibble(
  diff_total = malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko$Total_Population - malta_master_full$Total_Population,
  diff_adult = malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko$Adult_Population - malta_master_full$Adult_Population
)

ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = diff_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#3B1F5E") +
  labs(title = "Total_Population: Khomenko - original", x = "Difference", y = "Cells") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r sanity-hist-adult, fig.height=4}
ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = diff_adult)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#3B1F5E") +
  labs(title = "Adult_Population: Khomenko - original", x = "Difference", y = "Cells") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Sanity check: map of the change (Total_Population)

```{r sanity-map, fig.height=6}
map_data <- malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko %>%
  select(gid) %>%
  mutate(diff_total = diff_df$diff_total)

cap <- max(abs(quantile(map_data$diff_total, c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE)))
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pmax(pmin(diff_total, cap), -cap)), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027", midpoint = 0,
                       na.value = "grey90", name = "Δ Total_Population\n(Khomenko - original)") +
  labs(title = "Change in Total_Population per cell (Khomenko reallocation)") +
  theme_void()
```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko,
        file.path(data_dir, "malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko.rds"))
cat("Saved malta_master_full_reallocated_khomenko.rds — malta_master_full.rds untouched.\n")
```
